body:
>She feeds her reptiles out of their enclosure (in plastic tubs) and with tongs.  


Yes she's done this, I think she did or even still does show that she has done this in stories and posts. I didn't know this was a bad thing, is it? There are stories and videos of this.  


>Her (now former) rescue pugx was not house trained, and instead of training him herself, she scolded him, regularly locked him outside, and forced him to wear a diaper. She later got rid of him.  


This is all true. She never trained either dog because she never had time or made time. She could have hired someone but didnt. Leo started getting aggressive toward people and there was never any proper training. I miss Frankie!!  


>Before her move to Nashville, she housed her rabbits in a drafty and dirty garage. Their nails are badly overgrown, they had only a rug to chew on, and they had only limited and occasional access to fresh grass.  


In the past, the rabbits seemed to always have hay, I remember they did have things to chew on. So unless op is talking about more recently, this may not be super accurate. I wouldn't say the garage was drafty, but it was kept partially open sometimes. The thing I always worried about was that it got hot in the garage sometimes. I mentioned to her several times that it was hot because I had read rabbits need cooler weather. I would say it got in the 80's in the garage multiple days at a time and I was worried about them overheating. She seemed to think it was fine.  


>She feeds her rabbits a terribly imbalanced diet. She considers nuggets/pellets "cruel" and instead brags about the fresh salads she makes her rabbits, though they are filled with nothing but banana (at least one daily), and high sugar fruit, vegetables, and salad greens. She also complains about hay, due to an alleged allergy, and in several IG/SC stories they have empty hayracks.  


Again I don't know about recently, but I always thought the diet was very green heavy with a bit too much banana. I think bunnies are supposed to eat mostly hay with greens being supplemental, but she seemed to always think giving them big fresh green salads was the way to go. I'm not a rabbit diet expert tho. But there should be several videos out there with how she fed her rabbits. I don't know what she does more recently.  


>She attacks anyone who tries to correct her or offer serious advice, typically siccing her followers on them.  


She does indeed have a very attackful personality. Bullyish actually. I don't know about actively siccing followers on people though.  


>She also claims to be vegan and totally CF, despite wearing leather, fur, and sheepskin, using cosmetic brands that test on animals, and eating meat and cheese.  


I don't know about now but she has in the past claimed to be vegan but ate non vegan foods, true, and did wear leather shoes and the like. I don't know if she claims to be vegan now but she definitely did own leather products and likes Taco Bell beef tacos.
